connections.why: Hales drew a lesson for bleeding from his measurements: bleed at intervals rather than all at once.

Joseph Black named the gas he weighed out of magnesia "fixed air" after Stephen Hales, who had shown that alkaline salts hold a great quantity of it; the same Hales first measured the force of the blood.
